title: feature-deployment-statesboard-and-measurement-index
content:
Purpose: single-pane workbook to track deployment states for features, the primary measurement to watch, and quick preflight checks for go/no-go. This is intentionally compact so PMs and Ops can triage the next-30-day work rapidly.

How to use:
- Update the State column daily; use only the canonical states (backlog, scheduled, building, validating, staged, released, rollback-required).
- Measurement Index is the primary KPI (1 metric only) plus two supporting signals. Keep the metric formula and the owner in the row.
- Quick Preflight: 6 checks that must be green before traffic shift. Mark with initials when complete.
- Risk + Contingency: short note and immediate fallback (model variant, traffic cut %, region).

Sheet Columns (canonical order):
1) Feature ID
2) Short name
3) State
4) Owner (PM / Eng lead)
5) Target window (week-of)
6) Measurement Index (metric name | formula | owner)
7) Baseline / target
8) Acceptance criteria (bulleted short form)
9) Risk level (low/med/high)
10) Contingency (action + rollback trigger)
11) Quick Preflight (6 checks)
12) Stakeholder signoffs (comma-separated)
13) Notes / outstanding blockers

Sample rows:
- F-244 | conversational-context-window | validating | Maya Singh / Tom R. | week-of-2025-01-27 | conv-latency-p95 | 320ms -> target < 350ms | 1) end-to-end p95 < 350ms (staging), 2) accuracy delta < 1% on eval set | med | fallback to smaller context variant / disable long-context routing if p95>500ms | preflight: [infra perf ok, model bundle validated, canary traffic ready, eval pass, logs/alerts configured, docs updated] | signoffs: Maya Singh, Tom R., Ops: Marcus Chen | blockers: kv-cache bug (PR #4001)

- F-301 | embeddings-async-batcher | staged | Priya K. / Andre M. | week-of-2025-02-03 | embeddings-throughput | 1200 qps -> target >= 1k qps | 1) batch latency median <50ms, 2) CPU util <70% | low | enable autoscale policy + throttling at 2k qps | preflight: [queue metrics monitored, batcher config validated, infra scaling test ok, smoke eval, quotas set, alert thresholds tuned] | signoffs: Priya K., Infra: Andre M., SRE: Elena V. | blockers: none

- F-286 | rerank-fallback-policy | scheduled | Liam O. / Chen W. | week-of-2025-02-17 | rerank-precision@10 | baseline 0.34 -> target >=0.36 | 1) precision@10 >=0.36 on holdout, 2) fallback latency < 60ms | high | fallback to legacy ranker & reduce traffic to 20% if precision drops >5% | preflight: [canary dataset run, metrics dashboards, latency SLA check, AB test plan, rollback playbook linked, legal review] | signoffs: Liam O., ML: Chen W., Legal: S. Park | blockers: dataset labeling lag

Quick Preflight checklist (template, tick with initials):
- Infra perf smoke (region replicas, GPUs/instances verified)
- Model artifacts validated (checksum + size + quantization flag)
- Canary run results within acceptance (attach URL)
- Observability wired (dashboards, SLOs, alerts)
- Runbook & rollback steps published (link)
- Comms plan done (customer comms, #channel updated, on-call notified)

Operational run notes (notes to self / in-progress):
- Consider adding a numeric urgency score (0-10) to help triage when multiple features hit the same week.
- We still lack a compact signal for 'quality drift' across rollouts; propose a single daily eval job that yields a drift index (tracked under Measurement Index when present).
- Slack thread: #prodops-rollouts has a >50 message backlog tied to F-244; escalate if not cleared by EOD Friday.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we enforce a 'staged' min duration of 72 hours for model-backed features? (Eng Ops leaning yes; PMs want flexibility)
- Should contingency actions be prescriptive (exact % traffic cut) or descriptive (reduce traffic until metric stabilizes)? Current preference: prescriptive triggers reduce ambiguity.

Links and artifacts:
- Rollout playbook (confluence:PRODOPS-748)
- Canary dashboard: https://grafana.company.internal/d/rollouts/canary-fleet
- Related tickets: JIRA PROJ-2024, PROJ-2101

Last update notes:
- 2025-01-14: added Acceptance Criteria column and reworked preflight to 6 canonical checks (Aisha P.).
- 2024-12-02: initial template created during ops sync; sample rows from Jan sprint.

Owners: Aisha Patel (template owner), product-ops team for ongoing maintenance.
